title: Check current tote task and resend tote task command using the Tote Management API page (Obeyba/Aveva API features)
summary: Use the AVEVA/Obeyba “API Features for Tote Management” page to retrieve the current tote task (“Get Tote Task”) and, when a tote command previously errored or failed to execute, resend it (“Resend Tote Task”). Confirm the “Get Tote Task” output updates after resending.
when_to_use: When a tote task command encountered an error or failed to execute and you need to verify the current tote task and resend the tote task command using the Tote Management API features page.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the Tote Management API features actions (“Get Tote Task” and, when needed, “Resend Tote Task”) and verify observable output changes.
access_or_tools_needed: AVEVA/Obeyba Tote Management API features page controls: “Get Tote Task” and “Resend Tote Task”.

access_required: Access to the AVEVA/Obeyba “API Features for Tote Management” page.
system_preconditions: You must be logged in to Obeyba to use the API features.

visual_references.description: Totes Aveva API page showing “API Features for Tote Management” with “Get Tote Task” and “Resend Tote Task”, including the login prompt context (“Are you logged in to Obeyba?”).

steps.title: Open the Tote Management API features page (Obeyba/Aveva)
steps.purpose: Access the controls needed to retrieve the current tote task and resend a failed tote task command.
steps.instruction: Open the AVEVA/Obeyba page titled like “API Features for Tote Management” that contains the controls “Get Tote Task” and “Resend Tote Task”.
steps.expected_result: The page shows the “Get Tote Task” and “Resend Tote Task” controls.
steps.healthy_condition: Both “Get Tote Task” and “Resend Tote Task” are visible on the Tote Management API features page.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not show the “Get Tote Task” / “Resend Tote Task” controls, or the page indicates you are not logged in to Obeyba.

actions.label: Verify Tote Management API features page is open
actions.exact_action: Open the “API Features for Tote Management” page shown in the training frame (titled like “API Features for Tote Management”).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the page indicates you are not logged in to Obeyba, do not proceed with resend actions; resolve login first.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Get Tote Task" retrieves the current tote task; "Resend Tote Task" resends a command to a tote that encountered an error or failed to execute.

steps.title: Confirm you are logged in to Obeyba
steps.purpose: Ensure API actions can be executed successfully.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Management API features page, confirm the login state indicates you are logged in to Obeyba before using “Get Tote Task” or “Resend Tote Task”.
steps.expected_result: You are logged in to Obeyba (login indicator/prompt is not blocking API actions).
steps.healthy_condition: No “not logged in” condition is present; API controls can be used.
steps.failure_condition: The page indicates you are not logged in to Obeyba.

actions.label: Check login state
actions.exact_action: Confirm you are logged in to Obeyba before using the API features.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the page indicates you are not logged in to Obeyba, do not proceed with resend actions; resolve login first.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript context includes: “Are you logged in to Obeyba?”

steps.title: Retrieve the current tote task using “Get Tote Task”
steps.purpose: Establish the current tote task state before deciding whether a resend is needed.
steps.instruction: Use the “Get Tote Task” function on the Tote Management API features page to retrieve the current tote task.
steps.expected_result: The “Get Tote Task” output populates with the current tote task information.
steps.healthy_condition: “Get Tote Task” returns current tote task data (not blank/no data).
steps.failure_condition: “Get Tote Task” returns blank/no data or does not return a current task.

actions.label: Run Get Tote Task
actions.exact_action: Use the “Get Tote Task” function to retrieve the current tote task.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if “Get Tote Task” does not return a current task (blank/no data).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Get Tote Task" ... "Retrieves the current tote task."

steps.title: Resend the tote task command using “Resend Tote Task” (only when needed)
steps.purpose: Re-issue a tote command that previously encountered an error or failed to execute.
steps.instruction: If the tote task previously encountered an error or failed to execute, use “Resend Tote Task” on the same Tote Management API features page to resend the command.
steps.expected_result: The “Resend Tote Task” action is executed (command resent) for the tote that previously errored/failed.
steps.healthy_condition: Resend is performed for the tote task that needs re-issuing.
steps.failure_condition: Resend is not performed when required, or resend does not result in any observable change after re-checking with “Get Tote Task”.

actions.label: Run Resend Tote Task
actions.exact_action: Use “Resend Tote Task” to resend the command.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if “Resend Tote Task” does not produce any observable change in the subsequent “Get Tote Task” output.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Resend Tote Task" ... "Resends a command to a tote that encountered an error or failed to execute."

steps.title: Verify “Get Tote Task” output updates after resending
steps.purpose: Confirm the resend had an effect and the tote task state/values reflect the resent command.
steps.instruction: Run “Get Tote Task” again and compare the output to the prior “Get Tote Task” results to confirm the tote task information updates after resending.
steps.expected_result: After “Resend Tote Task”, the “Get Tote Task” output reflects the current tote task (task state/values update rather than remaining unchanged in the prior failed/error state).
steps.healthy_condition: The “Get Tote Task” output changes to reflect the resent command (observable update in the output fields).
steps.failure_condition: The “Get Tote Task” output remains unchanged and continues to reflect the prior failed/error state.

actions.label: Re-run Get Tote Task
actions.exact_action: Observe that the “Get Tote Task” output reflects the current tote task after resending (e.g., task state/values update rather than remaining unchanged).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if “Resend Tote Task” does not produce any observable change in the subsequent “Get Tote Task” output.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate expected result: “Get Tote Task” returns the current tote task, and after “Resend Tote Task” the tote task information updates rather than staying in the prior failed/error state.

success_criteria: “Get Tote Task” returns current tote task data (not blank/no data).
After “Resend Tote Task”, a subsequent “Get Tote Task” shows observable updates (task state/values change rather than remaining in the prior failed/error state).
healthy_conditions: You are logged in to Obeyba to use the API features.
“Get Tote Task” returns current tote task information.
After resending, “Get Tote Task” output updates to reflect the resent command.
failure_conditions: “Get Tote Task” returns blank/no data or does not return a current task.
“Resend Tote Task” produces no observable change in the subsequent “Get Tote Task” output.
The page indicates you are not logged in to Obeyba.
escalation_guidance: If “Get Tote Task” does not return a current task (blank/no data), stop and escalate.
If “Resend Tote Task” does not produce any observable change in the subsequent “Get Tote Task” output, stop and escalate.
If the page indicates you are not logged in to Obeyba, resolve login first and do not proceed with resend actions.
